+import { expect, test } from 'bun:test'
+
+import { validateAddress } from '@/features/checkout/validate'
+
+test('an empty form reports the missing name', () => {
+    expect(validateAddress({ name: '', street: '', postcode: '', city: '' })).toEqual(['Vul je naam in.'])
+})
+
+test('a lowercase postcode is accepted', () => {
+    const address = { name: 'Sanne', street: 'Dorpsstraat 1', postcode: '8911 ab', city: 'Leeuwarden' }
+    expect(validateAddress(address)).toEqual([])
+})

@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+export type Address = {
+    name: string
+    street: string
+    postcode: string
+    city: string
+}
+
+const POSTCODE = /^[1-9][0-9]{3} ?[A-Z]{2}$/
+
+export function normalizePostcode(value: string) {
+    return value.trim().toUpperCase()
+}
+
+export function validateAddress(address: Address) {
+    if (address.name.trim() === '') return ['Vul je naam in.']
+    if (address.street.trim() === '') return ['Vul je straat en huisnummer in.']
+    if (!POSTCODE.test(normalizePostcode(address.postcode))) return ['Deze postcode klopt niet.']
+    if (address.city.trim() === '') return ['Vul je woonplaats in.']
+    return []
+}

+import { useState } from 'react'
+

+
+export function PaymentStep({ onPay }: { onPay: (bank: string) => void }) {
+    const [bank, setBank] = useState(BANKS[0].id)
+    return (
+        <fieldset className="payment-step">
+            <legend>Betaal met iDEAL</legend>
+            <select value={bank} onChange={(event) => setBank(event.target.value)}>
+                {BANKS.map((option) => (
+                    <option key={option.id} value={option.id}>
+                        {option.name}
+                    </option>
+                ))}
+            </select>
+            <button type="button" onClick={() => onPay(bank)}>

+            </button>
+        </fieldset>
+    )
+}
